House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for capital improvements at the Magnus Veterans Wellness Clinic.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MAGNUS VETERANS FOUNDATION. +]

[+$900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Magnus Veterans Foundation to design, construct, renovate, equip, and furnish capital improvements to the Magnus Veterans Wellness Clinic in the city of Dayton. This appropriation includes money for major projects that reconfigure, renovate, and expand existing space; energy efficiency improvements; major projects that preserve or replace HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems; and other site renovations to support ongoing operations. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for capital improvements at the Magnus Veterans Wellness Clinic.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MAGNUS VETERANS FOUNDATION.

$900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Magnus Veterans Foundation to design, construct, renovate, equip, and furnish capital improvements to the Magnus Veterans Wellness Clinic in the city of Dayton. This appropriation includes money for major projects that reconfigure, renovate, and expand existing space; energy efficiency improvements; major projects that preserve or replace HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems; and other site renovations to support ongoing operations. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Magnus Veterans Foundation to design, construct, renovate, equip, and furnish capital improvements to the Magnus Veterans Wellness Clinic in the city of Dayton. This appropriation includes money for major projects that reconfigure, renovate, and expand existing space; energy efficiency improvements; major projects that preserve or replace HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems; and other site renovations to support ongoing operations. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
